title: Turn sales call notes into CRM updates and next steps
summary: Paste messy call notes or a transcript and get a short summary, CRM fields, dated next steps for both sides, and a follow-up email draft. You review before saving.

tests.prompt:
Turn these sales call notes into a CRM-ready update.

Call notes / transcript: [PASTE NOTES]
My role: [MY TITLE]
Prospect: [NAME], [TITLE] at [COMPANY]
Call date: [DATE]

Output exactly:
**Summary:** 3–5 sentences of what was discussed (no fluff).
**Fields to update:**
- Stage suggestion: [STAGE]
- Pain / goal: …
- Budget signals: … (or "not discussed")
- Timeline: … (or "not discussed")
- Competitors mentioned: …
- Decision makers: …
**Next steps for me:** dated checklist
**Next steps for them:** dated checklist
**Follow-up email draft:** under 100 words confirming what we agreed

Rules: Do not invent numbers, commitments, or people not in the notes. Mark unknowns as "not discussed".

setup.agent: Chat model after the call; optional Zapier/Make to drop output into HubSpot notes
steps: After the call, paste notes or a transcript into the prompt with names and date filled in.
Run the prompt and skim for invented facts.
Paste the summary and fields into your CRM note or activity.
Create tasks from the "Next steps for me" list with due dates.
Edit and send the follow-up email the same day.
setup.approvalStep: Check every field against your memory of the call before saving to the CRM.
failureModes: Inventing budget or timeline that was never said
Assigning next steps to the wrong person
Summaries that miss the actual objection

faq.q: What if my notes are messy?
faq.a: The prompt still works, but clearer notes get cleaner fields. Bullet the must-keep facts before you paste.
Try it on one call and compare to your own summary before relying on it.
